decisions.reason: Proven government adoption and over 30 APIS connections show the option's value has resolved favourably, so the firm should commit further rather than abandon it.

Demand for travel health requirements keeps fading and no results have been reported, but the API is cheap to keep and could be folded into the verification offer, so the option stays open for one more year.
The cyber awareness module costs little to run alongside the firm's certified training resources, and its value is still uncertain, so keeping it preserves upside.
Behaviour analysis is central to the firm's specialist detection expertise and could expand into new sectors, so the option is worth holding while its prospects resolve.
Passenger profiling builds on the firm's aviation security know-how at low maintenance cost, and its value is still emerging, so the firm retains it.
The verification platform sits close to the established offer with low marginal cost and fits the growing need for digital travel document checks, so it is kept while results develop.
